mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 underperforms as industrial output decline signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 100,000 per month indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% signals economic weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST both decline in current month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.
